receipt.public_excerpt: What chances does an automatically-generated piece of scientific misinformation have to do so?

evidence_items.explanation: LeCun answered 'ZERO!' to this question in late 2022. That backs Marcus's paraphrase in substance, though LeCun was speaking about scientific misinformation.

receipt.public_excerpt: the main hurdles which is how to disseminate it widely and how to get people to believe in it.

evidence_items.explanation: LeCun argued that spreading misinformation and getting people to believe it were the real barriers. This is the general point the later cases test.

receipt.public_excerpt: A false report of an explosion at the Pentagon, accompanied by an apparently AI-generated image, spread on Twitter on Monday morning, sparking a brief dip in the stock market.

evidence_items.explanation: AI-generated false content spread widely and had a measurable real-world effect, a clear case of traction.
